name: Ai Gangu
source:
Popular girl is sold for her father's debt. Main character receives the girl as a birthday present and trains her as slave.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
受歡迎的女孩為了償還父親欠下的債而遭到變賣。主角收到女孩作為生日禮物，並把她調教成奴隸。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
